<USER_REQUEST>
Project: "Fractal Garden", an interactive web app that turns a recursive fractal tree into relaxing music. We will build it in steps. This is STEP 1: only the recursion and animation. Do not add any audio yet.

Tech: HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript (ES modules), HTML5 Canvas. No frameworks, no backend, no external libraries.

Files:
- index.html
- style.css
- js/tree.js (pure recursion logic, no drawing)
- js/renderer.js (canvas drawing and animation)
- js/main.js (connects UI, tree and renderer)

Recursion (tree.js):
- Write a recursive function that generates a binary fractal tree with a clear base case.
- Return a list of branch events. Each event has: id, parentId, depth, start x/y, end x/y, length, angle, side (left/right/trunk), isLeaf, startTime, duration.
- Order startTime so that a branch starts growing only after its parent finishes. This list will drive the music later.
- Support an optional random seed so the same settings always give the same tree.

Parameters (sliders with visible values):
- Depth: 1 to 10, default 7
- Branch angle: 10 to 60 degrees, default 25
- Length ratio: 0.5 to 0.8, default 0.72
- Randomness: 0 to 1, default 0.2
- Growth speed: 0.5x to 2x
- Seed number, plus a "New seed" button

Animation:
- Branches grow smoothly using requestAnimationFrame.
- Thicker trunk, thinner outer branches, soft glowing leaves at the base case.
- Buttons: Grow, Pause/Resume, Reset.

Design:
- Calm night garden theme: deep blue-green gradient, soft colors, gentle fireflies.
- Responsive on desktop and mobile; the tree always fits inside the canvas.
- Accessible: labelled controls, keyboard support, good contrast, respect prefers-reduced-motion.

After building, run it locally, test every slider including depth 1 and depth 10, fix any console errors, and tell me how to open it.
</USER_REQUEST>

### What Was Built
- [index.html](file:///d:/University/UIU_Hackathon/Fractal%20Garden%20Hackathon/index.html): Semantic layout with canvas stage, live status pill (`aria-live="polite"`), playback buttons (`Grow`, `Pause`/`Resume`, `Reset`), labelled range sliders with live `<output>` readouts (`Depth` 1–10 default 7, `Branch angle` 10–60° default 25°, `Length ratio` 0.5–0.8 default 0.72, `Randomness` 0–1 default 0.20, `Growth speed` 0.5x–2.0x default 1.0x), and `Seed` input + `New seed` button.

- [js/tree.js](file:///d:/University/UIU_Hackathon/Fractal%20Garden%20Hackathon/js/tree.js): Pure recursive `generateFractalTree` (no DOM/Canvas) with base case `depth >= maxDepth`, optional deterministic Mulberry32 PRNG (`createSeededRandom`), and chronologically ordered branch events (`id`, `parentId`, `depth`, `startX`, `startY`, `endX`, `endY`, `length`, `angle`, `side`, `isLeaf`, `startTime`, `duration`) where `child.startTime = parent.startTime + parent.duration`.

- [js/main.js](file:///d:/University/UIU_Hackathon/Fractal%20Garden%20Hackathon/js/main.js): Connects controls, `generateFractalTree`, `TreeRenderer`, keyboard shortcuts (`G`, `Space`, `R`, `N`), and dynamic `prefers-reduced-motion` updates.

I have added Step 2 Web Audio sound to **Fractal Garden** (without audio export yet) while keeping the tree animation intact.

### Changes Made
- [js/audio.js](file:///d:/University/UIU_Hackathon/Fractal%20Garden%20Hackathon/js/audio.js): Created `GardenAudio` using the Web Audio API:
  - Initializes and unlocks `AudioContext` only after a user click (`unlock()`, `startGrowth()`, `setAmbientEnabled()`, mute/volume controls).
  - Fetches and decodes `trunk.mp3`, `branch.mp3`, `leaf.mp3`, `ambient-rain.mp3`, and `ambient-night.mp3` from `assets/audio/`, skipping leading silence (`findActiveStartOffset`). If any file is missing or fails to decode, emits a warning status listing the missing filename(s) and switches smoothly to soft synthesized fallback tones / ambient noise.
  - Maps trunk to `trunk.mp3`, normal branches to `branch.mp3` pitch-shifted via `playbackRate` on a C major pentatonic scale (`0, 2, 4, 7, 9` semitones) limited to 2 octaves (`0..24` semitones) with deeper branches playing higher pitches and quieter gain, and base-case leaves to soft `leaf.mp3`.
  - Applies `StereoPannerNode` left/right panning from each branch's `endX` position, soft linear attack/release envelopes on every note, an algorithmic `ConvolverNode` reverb, and a master `DynamicsCompressorNode`.
  - Quantizes branch notes to a 70 BPM 16th-note grid (`~0.214s`), enforces a minimum gap (`0.14s`), and caps simultaneous notes at `8`.
  - Loops `ambient-rain.mp3` and `ambient-night.mp3` quietly with smooth fade-in and fade-out.
- [js/renderer.js](file:///d:/University/UIU_Hackathon/Fractal%20Garden%20Hackathon/js/renderer.js): Added `onProgress(elapsed, prevElapsed, state)` callback to emit frame progress to the audio trigger loop without altering animation behavior.
- [js/main.js](file:///d:/University/UIU_Hackathon/Fractal%20Garden%20Hackathon/js/main.js): Wired `GardenAudio` to branch growth events, `Master volume` / `Ambient volume` sliders, `Mute` / `Ambient: On/Off` toggles, missing-file status notice, and synchronized `Grow`, `Pause`/`Resume`, and `Reset` controls (`M` key shortcut also toggles mute).
- [index.html](file:///d:/University/UIU_Hackathon/Fractal%20Garden%20Hackathon/index.html) & [style.css](file:///d:/University/UIU_Hackathon/Fractal%20Garden%20Hackathon/style.css): Added the Sound section controls and an inline SVG favicon to eliminate the `/favicon.ico` 404 logged during your earlier `11:21` browser visit.

- `node --check` passed on [js/tree.js](file:///d:/University/UIU_Hackathon/Fractal%20Garden%20Hackathon/js/tree.js), [js/renderer.js](file:///d:/University/UIU_Hackathon/Fractal%20Garden%20Hackathon/js/renderer.js), [js/audio.js](file:///d:/University/UIU_Hackathon/Fractal%20Garden%20Hackathon/js/audio.js), and [js/main.js](file:///d:/University/UIU_Hackathon/Fractal%20Garden%20Hackathon/js/main.js).

args.Content:
# Fractal Garden

An interactive, framework-free web app that turns a recursive binary fractal tree into relaxing generative music and nocturnal ambient soundscapes using HTML5 Canvas and the Web Audio API.

## How to Run

Because Fractal Garden uses ES modules (`<script type="module">`) and fetches audio files from `assets/audio/`, serve it over a local HTTP server rather than opening `index.html` via `file://`.

### Option 1: Python (recommended)

```bash
python -m http.server 4173 --bind 127.0.0.1
```

Then open **`http://127.0.0.1:4173/`** in your browser.

### Option 2: Node.js

```bash
npx serve -l 4173
```

Then open **`http://localhost:4173/`**.

> Note: Modern browsers require a user click before audio starts. Click **Enter the Garden** (or **Play**) to start sound.

---

## How the Recursion Works

The tree geometry and growth timeline are generated purely in [`js/tree.js`](js/tree.js) without any DOM or Canvas calls. Starting from a root trunk at `(0, 0)` with `depth = 1`, each branch computes its endpoint, records a timed branch event, and recursively spawns a **left** and **right** child branch only after its own duration finishes (`child.startTime = parent.startTime + parent.duration`).

When `depth === maxDepth` (the **base case**), recursion terminates and marks that branch as a glowing leaf (`isLeaf = true`). An optional seeded PRNG (Mulberry32) ensures the same parameters and seed always produce the exact same tree and musical event sequence.

### Pseudocode

```text
function buildBranch(parentId, depth, x, y, length, angle, side, startTime):
    endX = x + cos(angle) * length
    endY = y + sin(angle) * length
    isLeaf = (depth >= maxDepth)
    duration = baseDuration * (length / trunkLength)^0.45

    events.push({ id, parentId, depth, x, y, endX, endY, length, angle, side, isLeaf, startTime, duration })

    // Base case: stop at maxDepth (becomes a glowing leaf)
    if isLeaf:
        return

    childStart = startTime + duration
    for childSide in ["left", "right"]:
        childAngle = angle ± branchAngle + seededVariation()
        childLength = length * lengthRatio * seededVariation()
        buildBranch(id, depth + 1, endX, endY, childLength, childAngle, childSide, childStart)
```

---

## Music & Audio Mapping

Each branch event in the sorted list drives both the Canvas growth animation and the Web Audio synthesis/sample playback:

| Element | Audio Source | Pitch / Frequency | Panning (`StereoPannerNode`) | Dynamics & Effects |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Trunk (`depth = 1`)** | `trunk.mp3` | Unshifted root (`1.0x`) | Center (`0.0`) | Warm foundational gain (`0.45`), moderate reverb |
| **Normal Branches (`2 .. maxDepth-1`)** | `branch.mp3` | Pitch-shifted via `playbackRate` onto **C major** (`0, 2, 4, 7, 9`) or **A minor** (`-3, 0, 2, 4, 7`) pentatonic over 2 octaves; deeper = higher, favoring active pad chord tones | Left/right pan from normalized `endX` (`[-0.85, +0.85]`) | Quieter at deeper levels (`0.84^(depth-2)`), brightness filter opens with growth |
| **Leaves (base case)** | `leaf.mp3` | Unshifted soft chime + resolving tonic chord bloom at finish | Normalized `endX` (`[-0.85, +0.85]`) | Very soft gain, subtle filtered delay (`0.32s`), lush reverb (`0.95` send) |
| **Rain & Night** | `ambient-rain.mp3`, `ambient-night.mp3` | Seamless `2.5s` equal-power crossfaded loops | Stereo | Independent On/Off & volume; minimal reverb on Rain (`0.10`), moderate on Night (`0.42`) |
| **Pad** | Procedural oscillators (sine + triangle) | Slow 4-chord progression every 2 bars in selected scale | Stereo center | Slow filter & amplitude LFO movement, lush reverb (`0.95` send) |
| **Wind** | Procedural seeded pink noise | Band-pass sweep (`~200–550 Hz`) | Stereo center | Slowly shifting gust speed and strength via LFOs |

### Musical Comfort & Mastering Rules
- **Beat Grid & Polyphony**: Notes quantize to a `50–90 BPM` 16th-note grid (default `70 BPM`), enforce a minimum inter-note gap, and cap simultaneous voices at **8** so high depths (`Depth 10` = 1,023 branches) remain calm.
- **Click-Free Envelopes & Space**: Soft attack/release ramps on every note, dual crossfaded `ConvolverNode` reverb presets (**Small Garden**, **Forest**, **Open Sky**), `42 Hz` HPF / `11.5 kHz` LPF mix cleanup, master `DynamicsCompressorNode`, and `-1.5 dB` safety limiter.
- **Missing File Fallback**: If any MP3 in `assets/audio/` is missing or fails to decode, a clear notice is displayed and soft procedural synthesis is used instead.

---

## Features

- **Calm Night Garden Canvas**: Responsive high-DPI tree fitting at any viewport/depth, smooth `requestAnimationFrame` growth, playing-branch glow highlights, audio-reactive fireflies & leaves, and live recursion/note readout.
- **Interactive Controls**: Collapsible **Tree**, **Music**, **Volume**, and **How it works** panels (side panel on desktop, bottom sheet on mobile), **Focus mode**, **Fullscreen**, **Loop**, and **Sleep timer** (`5`, `10`, `20` min with gentle fade-out).
- **Presets**: **Calm Rain**, **Moonlit Night**, **Deep Forest**, and **Reset to defaults**.
- **Offline WAV Export**: Renders **Full tree once**, **1 minute**, or **3 minutes** via `OfflineAudioContext` using the exact same routing graph, deterministic schedule, and seeded randomness, outputting a `-1 dB` normalized **16-bit 44.1 kHz stereo `.wav`** with `2s` fade-in, `4s` fade-out, and unclipped reverb tail.
- **Accessibility & Reliability**: Welcome dialog, keyboard shortcuts (`Space` play/pause, `M` mute, `R` restart, `F` focus mode, `Esc` exit focus), `>= 44px` touch targets, `aria-live` updates, `prefers-reduced-motion` support, and automatic pause/resume on hidden tabs.

---

## Folder Structure

```text
Fractal Garden Hackathon/
├── index.html                  # App markup, welcome screen, controls, and export UI
├── style.css                   # Night garden theme, desktop sidebar & mobile bottom sheet
├── README.md                   # Project documentation
├── CREDITS.md                  # Audio credits and attribution
├── assets/
│   └── audio/
│       ├── trunk.mp3           # Trunk sound sample
│       ├── branch.mp3          # Branch sound sample (pitch-shifted)
│       ├── leaf.mp3            # Leaf chime sample
│       ├── ambient-rain.mp3    # Looping rain atmosphere
│       └── ambient-night.mp3   # Looping night atmosphere
└── js/
    ├── tree.js                 # Pure recursive fractal tree generator & bounds math
    ├── renderer.js             # HTML5 Canvas rendering, highlights & firefly animation
    ├── audio-graph.js          # Shared BaseAudioContext routing, DSP buffers & schedule
    ├── audio.js                # Live Web Audio playback engine, layers & harmony
    ├── audio-export.js         # OfflineAudioContext renderer & 16-bit WAV encoder
    └── main.js                 # UI wiring, presets, focus mode, sleep timer & shortcuts
```

args.CommandLine:
@'
import json, os, re, shutil

repo = r"d:\University\UIU_Hackathon\Fractal Garden Hackathon"
css_path = os.path.join(repo, "style.css")
with open(css_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    css = f.read()

opens = css.count("{")
closes = css.count("}")
print(f"style.css braces balanced: {opens} == {closes} ({opens == closes})")
assert opens == closes, "Unbalanced braces in style.css!"
assert "flex: 0 1 215px" not in css
assert "min-width: 180px" not in css
assert ".dock-volume .btn-pill" in css

src = r"C:\Users\HP\.gemini\antigravity\brain\dfb5f90a-1f5e-43b9-a532-96b0fc69408b\.system_generated\logs\transcript_full.jsonl"
dst_dir = os.path.join(repo, "ai-logs")
dst_jsonl = os.path.join(dst_dir, "transcript_full.jsonl")
dst_md = os.path.join(repo, "AI_PROMPT_LOGS.md")

os.makedirs(dst_dir, exist_ok=True)
shutil.copy2(src, dst_jsonl)

def clean_user_text(raw: str) -> str:
    text = raw.strip()
    m = re.search(r"<USER_REQUEST>\s*(.*?)\s*</USER_REQUEST>", text, flags=re.DOTALL)
    if m:
        return m.group(1).strip()
    return re.sub(r"</?USER_REQUEST>", "", text).strip()

entries = []
with open(dst_jsonl, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for line in f:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        obj = json.loads(line)
        t = obj.get("type")
        if t == "USER_INPUT":
            entries.append({
                "kind": "user",
                "step": obj.get("step_index"),
                "time": obj.get("created_at", ""),
                "text": clean_user_text(obj.get("content", "")),
            })
        elif t == "PLANNER_RESPONSE" and "content" in obj and obj.get("content", "").strip():
            entries.append({
                "kind": "assistant",
                "step": obj.get("step_index"),
                "time": obj.get("created_at", ""),
                "model": obj.get("model", ""),
                "text": obj["content"].strip(),
            })

user_count = sum(1 for e in entries if e["kind"] == "user")
assistant_count = sum(1 for e in entries if e["kind"] == "assistant")
first_time = entries[0]["time"] if entries else ""
last_time = entries[-1]["time"] if entries else ""

lines = [
    "# AI Prompt Logs — Fractal Garden",
    "",
    "This file documents the complete user prompt chain and AI coding agent responses used to build **Fractal Garden**.",
    "",
    "- **AI Coding Agent:** Google Antigravity",
    "- **Conversation ID:** `dfb5f90a-1f5e-43b9-a532-96b0fc69408b`",
    f"- **Total User Prompts Recorded:** {user_count}",
    f"- **Total Assistant Responses Recorded:** {assistant_count}",
    f"- **Session Time Range (UTC):** `{first_time}` to `{last_time}`",
    "- **Raw Machine-Readable Transcript:** [`ai-logs/transcript_full.jsonl`](ai-logs/transcript_full.jsonl)",
    "",
    "> **Note:** `ai-logs/transcript_full.jsonl` contains the exact unedited JSONL session log exported from the AI coding agent (including intermediate tool calls and subagent verification runs). This Markdown file extracts every user prompt and every assistant text response in chronological order for easy human review.",
    "",
    "---",
    "",
]

prompt_num = 0
for idx, e in enumerate(entries):
    if e["kind"] == "user":
        prompt_num += 1
        lines.append(f"## Prompt {prompt_num}")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append(f"- **Timestamp (UTC):** `{e['time']}`")
        lines.append(f"- **Step Index:** `{e['step']}`")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("### User Prompt")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append(e["text"])
        lines.append("")
        if idx == len(entries) - 1:
            lines.append("---")
            lines.append("")
    else:
        lines.append("### Assistant Response")
        lines.append("")
        meta = f"- **Timestamp (UTC):** `{e['time']}` | **Step Index:** `{e['step']}`"
        if e.get("model"):
            meta += f" | **Model:** `{e['model']}`"
        lines.append(meta)
        lines.append("")
        lines.append(e["text"])
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("---")
        lines.append("")

md_out = "\n".join(lines).rstrip() + "\n"
with open(dst_md, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
    f.write(md_out)

print(f"Updated transcript_full.jsonl: {os.path.getsize(dst_jsonl)} bytes, {sum(1 for _ in open(dst_jsonl, encoding='utf-8'))} lines")
print(f"Updated AI_PROMPT_LOGS.md: {os.path.getsize(dst_md)} bytes, {len(md_out.splitlines())} lines")
print(f"user_count={user_count}, assistant_count={assistant_count}, last_time={last_time}")
print("CREDITS.md bytes:", os.path.getsize(os.path.join(repo, "CREDITS.md")))
'@ | python -
